newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA CENTURY BOOSTS SRI LANKA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA CENTURY BOOSTS SRI LANKA.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Sanath Jayasuriya completed the third century of his test career on Monday,.
He contributed 130 not out to a comfortable Sri Lanka tea total of 237 for one in reply to India's 537 for eight declared.

Jayasuriya and Roshan Mahanama, unbeaten on 76, formed a chanceless partnership of 198, just 20 short of breaking the Sri Lankan second wicket record of 217 set by Sidath Wettimuny and Roy Dias against Pakistan in 1981-82 and equalled 13 years later by Asanka Gurusinha and Sanjeeva Ranatunga against Zimbabwe.

Jayasuriya completed his century in fine style, moving from 85 to 101 in five scoring strokes (2, 4, 4, 4, 2) as he took 16 runs off test debutant Nilesh Kulkarni, the left-arm spinner who took a wicket with his first delivery in a test on Sunday.
The left-handed opener's hundred came in 201 minutes off 138 balls and included 14 fours.
Mahanama, playing the supporting role, completed his 11th test half-century in 142 minutes off 115 balls with seven fours.
